name: Trendline breakout
idea: A signal on the first close beyond a trendline: above a falling resistance line, or below a rising support line. The idea has ended when the close is back across the line.

params.label: Line touches
params.help: How many swings must touch the line.

params.label: Break distance
params.help: How far beyond the line the close must be, in average true ranges (0 means any close beyond).

params.label: The idea is wrong beyond
params.help: The level that says the breakout failed: just beyond the broken line, or the far end of the move along the line.
choice_labels: The far end of the move along the line

params.label: Edge buffer
params.help: For 'just beyond the broken line': how many average true ranges beyond it.
